value.rationale: A universal convex-order minimum is a structural stochastic-geometric refinement of the classical quadratic invariant, simultaneously deciding every convex and concave squared-radius test on fixed-perimeter parallelograms, with complete equality rigidity and an only-if classification of invariant C^2 weights. The separately published single-point fourth-moment formula is prior-known and not counted as new value.
